question: Between the third Thursday and fourth Wednesday in Jan 1939, what was the net total capital inflow or outflow in thousands of dollars between the US and Latin America?
raw_response:
Extracted Jan. 18 and Jan. 25 Latin America figures:

Liabilities: 250,451 to 250,049 = -402
Assets: 97,471 to 95,746 = -1,725
Banking net: -402 - (-1,725) = +1,323
Security transactions, week ended Jan. 25: purchases 908 - sales 916 = -8

Net capital movement: 1,323 - 8 = 1,315 inflow

<FINAL_ANSWER>1,315 inflow</FINAL_ANSWER>
